body: Pre-built process definitions for common industries. Each template defines steps, transitions, forms, roles, SLAs, and required documents for a specific business process.

author: reek
body: A residential title search and insurance workflow. Steps: 1. Order intake -- agent enters property and buyer details 2. Title search -- examiner searches county records 3. Exception review -- underwriter reviews found exceptions 4. Document collection -- gather deeds, surveys, payoff letters 5. Commitment issuance -- generate title commitment 6. Closing preparation -- prepare settlement statement 7. Final review -- senior underwriter approval 8. Policy issuance -- generate final title policy
